name: Panther Mastery
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Panther Mastery sends you after the deadliest panthers. After your earlier trials, ten Shadowmaw Panthers are your quarry.

sections.title: The Deadliest Quarry
sections.body: Sir S. J. Erlgadin calls Shadowmaw Panthers the most dangerous cats in Stranglethorn's jungles. To prove yourself as a stalker, you crawl through dense underbrush and track ten elusive beasts. Their ferocity makes them harder to kill than to find.

faq.answer: Sir S. J. Erlgadin offers this hunt from the Nesingwary Expedition camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
You hunt ten Shadowmaw Panthers, which Erlgadin calls the deadliest panthers in all of Stranglethorn.

faq.q: Where does this fit in the hunting trials?
faq.answer: This is the third panther hunting trial, after the second Panther Mastery trial and before the fourth.

angles.text: As a hunter, you face Erlgadin's challenge to your reputation as a big game hunter. He expects you to stalk and slay the jungle's fiercest predators.
